run_command: docker compose up (contrib/docker-compose/basic.yml, requires PostgreSQL) or `make run` (go run main.go with RUN_MIGRATIONS=1 CREATE_ADMIN=1 against a local Postgres). PostgreSQL is the only supported DB.
host: http://127.0.0.1:8080 (binary/make run default LISTEN_ADDR); 0.0.0.0:8080 in Docker, published as host port 80 in the sample compose.
api_style: REST, no OpenAPI/Swagger spec served or checked in. Main REST API base path /v1/; plus compatibility APIs at /fever/ and /reader/api/0/.
spa: no (server-rendered) — Go html/template SSR with vanilla JS; no SPA framework.
auth: required. Web UI = session-cookie auth via a server-rendered login form (also WebAuthn/OIDC). REST API (/v1/) = HTTP Basic Auth or an API token via the X-Auth-Token header.

evidence.run_command: Makefile `run` target; contrib/docker-compose/basic.yml (miniflux + postgres, DATABASE_URL); README 'Works only with PostgreSQL'.
evidence.host: internal/config/options.go default LISTEN_ADDR 127.0.0.1:8080; Dockerfile ENV LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8080 EXPOSE 8080; compose ports 80:8080.
evidence.api_style: internal/http/server/routes.go registers /v1/, /fever/, /reader/api/0/; no openapi/swagger files; README API docs link is external.
evidence.spa: internal/ui renders server-side templates; README 'modern vanilla JavaScript only when necessary', assets bundled into the binary.
evidence.auth: internal/ui/routes.go isPublicRoute() only /login + /webauthn/login/*; internal/api/api.go chains validateAPIKeyAuth (X-Auth-Token) + validateBasicAuth; client README documents user/pass or apiToken.
